title: Decoupled approval against tampering
description: Query feedback about an action other than the one executed, so the agent cannot influence the feedback it is trained on.

source.title: Avoiding Tampering Incentives in Deep RL via Decoupled Approval
source.authors: Uesato, Kumar, Krakovna, Everitt, Ngo, Legg

prediction.rationale: Decoupled approval's claim: if feedback is collected about an action other than the one executed, the executed action cannot corrupt the feedback it is trained on. The lever corrupts only feedback about the executed step.
